pairedHistory.summary: A 24-hour historical screen of Denver–Kansas City and Yankees–Twins used the nearest prior Polymarket observation within 60 seconds of each Kalshi candle end. The best apparent 98¢ package cost $1.03 after current modeled fees and slippage.
pairedHistory.limitations: September 12–13, 2026. Comparisons are correlated quotes, not trades. Historical depth and achievable fills are unavailable. Current fees are applied as a counterfactual; cancellation and postponement rules also differ.
